decisions.reason: The registered PHP target Order/refund does not exist; the controller only defines refundForm and refundOld, while the GET form route is also incorrectly wired to Order/refund.
decisions.replacement: GET /kefuapi/order/refund_form/:id for the form and PUT /kefuapi/refund/refund/:id for an authorized after-sale refund

decisions.reason: The PHP GET mutates refund state, ignores the path parameter, reads a query parameter with the same name, and writes an order-status row using the refund id as oid.
The PHP route points to Login/ticket, but the 111-line Login controller defines only login, wechatAuth, getAppid, getLoginKey, and scanLogin; no ticket method or first-party caller exists.
decisions.replacement: Authenticated users use GET /api/user/service/record plus GET /api/ws/kefu; anonymous chat requires a separately specified signed visitor-session contract

decisions.reason: The PHP route points to StoreOrder/get_noPay, but the StoreOrder controller has no such method and ends after callBack; no first-party storefront call was found during the API-002 source audit.
decisions.replacement: GET /api/order/data for unpaid_count, or GET /api/order/list?status=0 for unpaid orders
